overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating LLM-generated survey responses using automatic metrics that compare model outputs to gold-standard human survey responses. The task is clearly NLG (generating survey answers), and the evaluation uses custom automatic metrics (accuracy and soft similarity) rather than traditional NLG metrics like BLEU/ROUGE. No LLM-as-judge or human evaluation is conducted. The extraction was generally reasonable but needed normalization of metric naming and removal of redundant entries.
